## Behavior
Describe expected and actual behavior, including exit code.

## Reproduction
Use synthetic or loopback targets; do not include client addresses, secrets or reports.

## Environment
SentryNet version, OS, .NET runtime, optional tool versions and sanitized command/config.

## Validation
Relevant tests, evidence keys and collection gaps. Security vulnerabilities belong in the private reporting process in SECURITY.md.
